item.title: Scheifele scores in overtime as the Jets beat the Blackhawks 3-2
item.description: Mark Scheifele scored at 2:06 of overtime to lift the Winnipeg Jets to a 3-2 victory over the Chicago Blackhawks.

item.title: No More Foundation launches anti-violence campaign ahead of the Women's World Cup
item.description: The No More Foundation launched an initiative on Tuesday that calls attention to violence against women and girls in Brazil with various initiatives surrounding the 2027 Women's World Cup.

item.title: Ryan Conwell scores 23 points and Louisville tops Syracuse 77-62
item.description: Ryan Conwell scored 23 points, he and Isaac McKneely combined for 10 3-pointers, and Louisville defeated Syracuse 77-62.

item.title: Andrej Stojakovic scores 21 points, No. 11 Illinois beats Oregon 80-54
item.description: Andrej Stojakovic had 21 points and 12 rebounds off the bench to lead No. 11 Illinois to an 80-54 victory over Oregon on Tuesday night.

item.title: Dak's career-high 22 points and career-high 10 rebounds help Colorado withstand Utah in 92-78 win
item.description: Bangot Dak scored a career-high 22 points and grabbed 10 rebounds and Colorado withstood Utah's second-half shooting barrage and beat the Utes 92-78.

item.title: Red Sox prospect Erik Rivera pitches in Boston uniform for Puerto Rico in exhibition
item.description: Red Sox minor league left-hander Erik Rivera pitched in his Boston uniform Tuesday night for Puerto Rico against his major league team in a preseason exhibition.

item.title: Cincinnati jumps out early, beats BYU 90-68
item.description: Cincinnati rolls past BYU in a lopsided Big 12 win, led by balanced scoring and strong shooting.

item.title: Arizona State beats No. 14 Kansas 70-60 in Hurley's potential home finale
item.description: Moe Odum scored 23 points, Massamba Diop added 19 and Arizona State pulled away late to beat No. 14 Kansas 70-60 on Tuesday night in what could be Sun Devils coach Bobby Hurley's final home game.

item.title: Morgan Fiedler runs Babylon's engine to Class B girls title
item.description: Point guard has 19 points, six assists in victory over Greenport/Southold

item.title: Stars extend franchise-record winning streak to 10 with 6-1 romp over Flames
item.description: Sam Steel scored twice and added an assist and the Dallas Stars extended their franchise-record winning streak to 10 games with a 6-1 romp over the Calgary Flames on Tuesday night.
